gitCommit.subject: i18n: a page fixed to its address's language is never overwritten by the outer provider
gitCommit.body:
i18n: a page fixed to its address's language is never overwritten by the outer provider

Console CI 41622232435 read lang="en" on /fr (twice) and /ar/products/dukan-erp: React runs the outer provider's
effects last, so the outer provider, still on the device's English until it followed, wrote the document for one
commit after the page had written its own language. A fixed provider now claims the document in a layout effect and
the outer one writes only when no page claims it. The new test records every value the lang attribute takes: it fails
on the old code and passes on this. The phone list comparison ignores line endings.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
(Public-site release: the console-only phone-field test change is left out; that test is not on this branch.)

(cherry picked from commit bb620d03a1128f8784a366b226d0fa82c2f57e4f)
